resources.string: Split expenses with your crew without the awkward money talks
Organize travel expenses with your friends, manage multiple currencies, and keep everyone on the same page from takeoff to touchdown.
Split expenses your way: equally, by exact amounts, percentages, or subunits for couples and families. Attach receipts to keep a clear paper trail.
Track shared physical cash alongside card expenses. Log cash withdrawals and pocket contributions with automatic multi-currency conversion.
Know your exact balance at any moment. Settle up seamlessly with peer confirmation so everyone agrees before a debt is marked paid.
Your friends have already added you to groups and logged expenses under %1$s. Tap below to retrieve all your data.
